Risk factors: diabetes, chronic hypertension, BMI over 30, existing
cardiovascular disease. Prevention: **low-dose aspirin** (150 mg at night, started before 16 weeks) and **calcium** if dietary intake is low. Vitamins C and E (listed in your notes) do **not** prevent pre-eclampsia and are not recommended.
